import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import App from '@src/response-apps/activity/app';
import { getBackendRealmAccess } from '@src/api/bot/realm-access-queries';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';
import dayjs from 'dayjs';
/** 宗门大比阶段中文映射 */
const COMPETITION_PHASE_CN: Record<string, string> = {
  NOT_STARTED: '未开始',
  REGISTRATION: '报名中',
  KNOCKOUT: '淘汰赛',
  PROMOTION: '晋级赛',
  ENDED: '已结束'
};

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const result = await App({ bid, uid: e.uid as number });
  const md = Format.createMarkdown();

  if (result.code === 'INVALID_USER') {
    md.addText('请先踏入仙途');

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  if (result.code !== 'OK') {
    md.addText('查询活动失败，请稍后再试。');

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  const realmAccess = await getBackendRealmAccess(bid);
  const visible = new Set([...realmAccess.moreVisibleCommands, ...realmAccess.foldVisibleCommands]);
  const { limitedEvent, guildCompetition, guildSecretRealmWar, access, overseasIsland, overseasIslandRequiredRealm } = result.data;
  const entries: Array<{ label: string; command: string; status: string; details: string[]; priority: number }> = [];

  entries.push({
    label: '限时活动',
    command: '/限时活动',
    status: limitedEvent.activeCount > 0 ? `进行中 ${limitedEvent.activeCount} 个` : '当前未开启',
    details: [],
    priority: limitedEvent.activeCount > 0 ? 0 : 2
  });

  if (visible.has('/新人狂欢')) {
    entries.push({ label: '新人狂欢', command: '/新人狂欢', status: '修行任务与签到', details: [], priority: 1 });
  }

  if (access.hasGuild) {
    const competitionActive = ['REGISTRATION', 'KNOCKOUT', 'PROMOTION'].includes(guildCompetition.phase);

    entries.push({
      label: '宗门大比',
      command: '/宗门大比',
      status: COMPETITION_PHASE_CN[guildCompetition.phase] ?? guildCompetition.phase,
      details: [],
      priority: competitionActive ? 0 : 2
    });
    const active = guildSecretRealmWar.phase === 'ACTIVE';
    const details: string[] = [];
    const start = dayjs(guildSecretRealmWar.activeStartAt);
    const end = dayjs(guildSecretRealmWar.activeEndAt);

    if (start.isValid() && end.isValid()) {
      details.push(`开放：${start.format('MM-DD HH:mm')} ~ ${end.format('MM-DD HH:mm')}`);
    }
    if (active) {
      details.push(`剩余攻击：${guildSecretRealmWar.remainingAttackCount}/${guildSecretRealmWar.maxAttackPerWeek}`);
    }
    const guild = guildSecretRealmWar.guild;

    if (guild) {
      details.push(`${guild.name} · 产量加成+${guild.outputBonusPct.toFixed(0)}%`);
      if (guild.occupation) {
        const occupation = guild.occupation;
        const label = occupation.source === 'CURRENT' ? '实时占领' : '上期占领';

        details.push(`${label}：S${occupation.top} / A${occupation.high} / B${occupation.low}（共${occupation.total}）`);
      }
    }
    entries.push({
      label: '灵脉攻防战',
      command: '/灵脉攻防战',
      status: active ? '争夺中' : '已封锁',
      details,
      priority: active ? 0 : 2
    });
  }

  if (access.canAccessOverseasIsland) {
    entries.push({
      label: '海外仙岛',
      command: '/海外仙岛',
      status: overseasIsland === 'ACTIVE' ? '进行中' : overseasIsland === 'INACTIVE' ? '当前未开启' : '状态暂未确认',
      details: overseasIslandRequiredRealm !== undefined ? [overseasIslandRequiredRealm ? `参与需${overseasIslandRequiredRealm}及以上` : '当前修为不足'] : [],
      priority: overseasIsland === 'ACTIVE' ? 0 : overseasIsland === 'INACTIVE' ? 2 : 1
    });
  }

  for (const entry of entries.sort((left, right) => left.priority - right.priority)) {
    const row = Format.createMarkdown().addButton(`[${entry.label}]`, { data: entry.command }).addText(` — ${entry.status}`);

    for (const detail of entry.details) {
      row.addNewline().addText(detail);
    }
    md.addBlockquote(row);
  }

  void message.send(
    FormatGui({
      isPrivate,
      bid,
      title: '仙界风云',
      content: md,
      footer: [...(visible.has('/礼包码') ? [{ label: '礼包码', command: '/礼包码' }] : []), { label: '返回福利', command: '/更多 福利' }]
    })
  );
});
